steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each assumption is matched to its source, and each headcount figure to the demand behind it.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Assumption with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the assumption

findings.title: Cost with no rate source
findings.fix: Name the source of the rate

findings.title: Headcount that does not follow from demand

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] demand-high.md:12  Assumption with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the assumption.
[medium] cost-rate.md:19  Cost with no rate source.
       Fix: Name the source of the rate.
[low] scenario-summary.md:26  Headcount that does not follow from demand.
       Fix: Recompute the headcount.
Not checked: Attrition beyond the assumptions.
pros: Checks an assumption with no source, a headcount that does not follow from the demand, and a cost with no rate source.
cons: Not checked: Attrition beyond the assumptions.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-workforce-scenario skill on the records for this review.
